cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The first RED run attempted to remove a non-empty intermediate fixture directory before replacing it with a symlink.
impact: The initial selector exposed a test-fixture setup error before product assertions; the fixture was corrected and the RED selector rerun.
lesson: Make intermediate-directory symlink probes replace their indexed child before removing the parent, and distinguish setup errors from product failures.

cause: Before the bounded stream implementation, the generic download route called read_bytes_and_sha256 and returned an in-memory Response; request Range headers were ignored and malformed or unsatisfiable ranges returned 200 full bodies.
impact: Generic artifact downloads were not memory-bounded and did not preserve the required MIME, Accept-Ranges, or explicit Range compatibility boundary.
lesson: Prove whole-file allocation and Range compatibility fail before changing the route, then keep one opened descriptor below hash and stream operations.

cause: The first bounded-stream implementation imported Starlette range exception classes from fastapi.responses, which does not export them in this environment.
impact: Focused pytest collection failed before the implementation could be exercised; the imports were corrected to the providing Starlette module.
lesson: Check the installed framework export boundary after adding compatibility helpers and keep collection failures distinct from runtime product evidence.

cause: The first post-implementation cleanup probe still patched the old read_bytes_and_sha256 method, so the new sha256 seam was not exercised and the HTTP response completed 200 instead of reaching the controlled hash failure boundary.
impact: The focused probe was corrected to patch the live sha256 symbol with raising=True; the subsequent focused run exercised cleanup successfully.
lesson: When a shared seam changes, patch the live helper actually called by the route and assert the callback executes before interpreting cleanup evidence.

cause: The first full production regression retained remediation-14's direct generic-alias assertion that the route returns a plain Response with an eagerly available body.
impact: The implementation was already streaming correctly; the regression assertion was updated to drain StreamingResponse and preserve the generic alias contract.
lesson: Update response-shape assertions when replacing whole-body responses with bounded streams, while retaining body and header compatibility checks.

cause: The first static scan command used shell quoting that left an unmatched double quote before rg executed.
impact: The static check was rerun with separate rg expressions and completed; no implementation change was based on the failed shell command.
lesson: Use shell-safe separate scan expressions for security checks and distinguish command syntax errors from source findings.

cause: The generic artifact download now hashes and streams from one safe opened descriptor with a 64 KiB chunk ceiling, explicit 512 MiB size policy, stable device/inode/size checks, response compatibility headers, and single/multipart range semantics.
impact: Focused stream/range/cleanup/TOCTOU/symlink/size probes passed 16 tests with one framework deprecation warning; callback counters were nonzero and all captured descriptors closed.
lesson: Require direct live-symbol probes for bounded chunks, header/range compatibility, cleanup, and read-time mutation before broader regression claims.

cause: The production classification artifact, index/list, generic download, HTTP status, classification consumer, and predecessor TOCTOU tests remained green after the bounded stream cutover.
impact: The complete package-local production suite passed 104 tests with one framework deprecation warning.
lesson: Run the complete production focus after the new stream probes and preserve list/index/classification and 500/503 boundaries.

cause: The existing classification typed contracts and projections remained unchanged by the repository stream seam.
impact: The four classification contract suites passed 49 tests; split/fold/OOF/holdout/weights/calibration/threshold and typed consumer contracts remain green.
lesson: Keep the bounded stream below classification typed contracts and rerun the full contract focus before closeout.

cause: The existing tests/test_api.py artifacts focus retains two completed-run fixture assumptions unrelated to bounded generic artifact streaming.
impact: Observed result: 2 failed, 6 passed, 31 deselected, 1 warning; report producer and stale completed-run fixtures remain outside scope.
lesson: Keep inherited report fixture failures separate from bounded artifact download evidence and do not alter protected report producers.

cause: The existing v1.8.6 consumer fixture supplies a non-canonical legacy prediction_result record rejected by the strict artifact-index validator before the route projection.
impact: Observed result: 1 failed, 3 passed; the failure predates this line and remains outside the frozen scope.
lesson: Do not relax the strict artifact-index validator or change unrelated legacy projection fixtures to manufacture a green gate.

cause: The existing artifact-integrity fixtures supply incomplete non-canonical classification_evidence records and stop at strict index validation.
impact: Observed result: 3 failed, 1 warning; canonical integrity behavior remains green in the remediation-15 production suite, so stale fixture repair is deferred.
lesson: Keep canonical integrity fixtures aligned in a separate scope and never weaken fail-closed validation to satisfy stale records.

cause: The final implementation passed syntax compilation, whitespace validation, and bounded-path static inspection; protected classification consumer and repository paths were unchanged.
impact: compileall exited 0, git diff --check exited 0, and the generic route contains no whole-body read, read_bytes_and_sha256 call, path-backed FileResponse, or path reopen; remaining FileResponse uses are unrelated report/export endpoints.
lesson: Pair runtime probes with compile/diff checks and explicitly distinguish unrelated path-backed endpoints from the hardened generic artifact seam.

cause: The bounded generic artifact stream, range compatibility, FD cleanup, read-time fail-closed probes, classification production regression, typed classification contracts, static checks, known-gate accounting, exact handoff, and formal event verification are complete for this package-local line.
impact: The package-local remediation is formally closed with focused runtime evidence and explicit inherited/external boundaries; no central, browser, provider, host, full-gate, or release claim is made.
lesson: Close a bounded production remediation only after exact RED/GREEN evidence, inherited gate separation, handoff, verified event chain, and explicit NOT VERIFIED external boundaries.

cause: The generic stream RED incident was resolved by the implemented bounded same-FD hash/stream seam and the final focused and production suites.
impact: The original RED incident is resolved: final focused probes passed 16 tests and the complete package-local production suite passed 104 tests; no unresolved product failure remains.
lesson: Close the original RED incident with a separate evidence-backed resolution event so formal unresolved accounting reflects the verified GREEN result.
